ideas.title: The Impact of Medicaid Funding Freeze on Vulnerable Populations
ideas.description: Investigate the effects of the Medicaid funding freeze on healthcare access and outcomes for vulnerable populations, including low-income families and individuals with disabilities.
questions: What are the specific effects of the Medicaid funding freeze on healthcare access?
How have vulnerable populations been impacted?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose significant wrongdoing and neglect by the Trump administration, with far-reaching implications for healthcare policy and access to care.
